params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $wt="$env:USERPROFILE\mhw-mods-pr90-integration"; Set-Location $wt; $json=Get-ChildItem BuildLogs\verification-report-*.json | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1; if(!$json){throw 'NO_REPORT'}; 'REPORT='+$json.FullName; $doc=Get-Content -Raw $json.FullName | ConvertFrom-Json; 'FAILED_RESULTS_BEGIN'; @($doc.results | Where-Object { $_.status -ne 'PASS' }) | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 12; 'FAILED_RESULTS_END'; $log=Get-ChildItem BuildLogs\verify-*.log | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1; 'FAIL_LINES_BEGIN'; Select-String -Path $log.FullName -Pattern 'FAIL:|failed|Failed|ERROR|Exception' -Context 2,10 | ForEach-Object {$_.ToString()}; 'FAIL_LINES_END'
